Decided to give this camera system a shot before a recent trip down to Florida and honestly wish I'd bought it sooner. The picture quality is surprisingly clear, even at dusk, and the wireless signal stayed solid the entire way down I-95 with zero dropouts. Installation took maybe 20 minutes, just wired it to my running lights and zip-tied the cable out of the way. The 7-inch monitor sits nicely on my dash without blocking my view. I'd absolutely recommend this to anyone towing travel trailers, boat trailers, or really anything bigger than a small utility trailer. It takes all the stress out of backing into tight campsite spots. Worth every penny.

Honestly wasn't sure what to expect for the price, but this little brick has been a pleasant surprise. It's noticeably smaller than I thought it'd be, barely sticks out of the outlet, which is great for my crowded power strip. Charging speed is decent. My iPad doesn't turbo-charge or anything, but it holds its own against the original Apple adapter. Probably takes about 20 minutes longer for a full top-up from dead, which I can live with. Build quality feels solid enough, no weird rattling or cheap plastic vibes. The only reason I'm knocking off a star is that it runs a little warm during longer charging sessions. Nothing alarming, just warmer than I'd prefer. For the money though, hard to complain. Would buy again.

Was looking for budget earbuds to use at the gym and didn't want to cry if I left them in a locker room. These are shockingly good for what they cost. The bass is actually there, which surprised me, and they get plenty loud without distortion. Cord feels like it won't shred immediately like the last pair I had from a big box store. Fit is comfortable for long walks and they stay put when jogging. Are they audiophile quality? Obviously not. But for under five bucks you genuinely can't do better. I've already ordered a second pair to keep in my desk at work. If you just need something reliable that sounds decent and won't make you furious when it eventually breaks, grab these.

Bought this as a backup case while waiting for my main one to ship, and honestly I might just keep using it. The slim profile was a pleasant surprise, it slides into my pocket without that sticky silicone drag. I had to trim a little around the Qi receiver opening to get a flush fit, but the material cut cleanly without fraying. Color-wise, the red leans more burgundy than bright cherry, which I actually prefer but some might not expect from the photos. Would definitely recommend to anyone running a wireless charging pad and wanting minimal bulk. Not heavy-duty protection, so if you drop your phone a lot maybe look elsewhere. For desk and light everyday use though, it's spot on.

I go through earbuds like crazy, usually the left side dies within three months, or they stop holding a charge. Decided to try these after returning a pair that cost twice as much, and honestly I'm kicking myself for not finding them sooner. Sound is solid for podcasts and music, pairing was instant with my phone, and the battery easily gets me through a full workday plus my commute. I've dropped them twice on pavement and they're totally fine. The fit stays put during runs too, which is usually my biggest complaint with wireless buds. If you're someone who's rough on electronics or just tired of babying expensive earbuds, these are absolutely the move. Bought a second pair for my brother who does construction work and he's equally happy.

Picked up a three-pack of these to replace the stock fans that came with my case and honestly the difference is night and day. My temps dropped about 6-7 degrees under load, which is wild for fans at this price point. The magnetic levitation bearing is super quiet, I can barely hear them even when my system is under heavy load during gaming sessions. The RGB looks fantastic too, really bright and even across all the fans without looking washed out. My only minor gripe is that the included controller requires some extra cable management, but honestly for what you're paying that's a fair tradeoff. Way better than spending way more on premium alternatives that perform basically the same. Definitely picking up another pack for my radiator soon.

For what they're charging, I expected a lot more. The plastic shell part seems okay at first glance but after two weeks of normal use the corners started cracking near the snap points. The front cover is way too floppy to stay closed on its own, so the auto wake/sleep feature barely works unless you set something on top of it. My iPad wakes up randomly in my bag constantly which kills the battery. The magnet strength is just not there. I've had ten dollar cases from random brands that held up better than this. Build quality just doesn't match the premium price tag at all. Honestly regret this purchase and would send it back if I still had the box.

Bought this to replace the terrible built-in speakers on my Samsung and honestly couldn't be happier with the whole thing. The wireless subwoofer paired up immediately without any fuss and I had everything running in maybe ten minutes. The difference during movie night was immediately noticeable, dialogue comes through crisp and clear while explosions actually have some real weight behind them now. I've got it sitting on my media console and it fits perfectly without looking bulky. The remote is straightforward and I like that I can tweak the bass level depending on what I'm watching. Music streaming over Bluetooth from my phone works flawlessly too. For what I paid, this absolutely exceeded my expectations and I'd recommend it to anyone wanting better sound without a complicated setup.

Picked this up to replace my aging tablet and honestly it's just okay. I expected better performance for the price point. The processor handles basic browsing fine but stutters when I have more than a few tabs open, which my old device didn't struggle with. Battery life is decent, getting me through most of the day with mixed use. The display looks vibrant at full brightness but washes out badly at lower settings, making nighttime reading annoying. Speakers are surprisingly loud though, no complaints there. Build quality feels a bit cheap and plasticky compared to what I anticipated. It works for checking email and watching YouTube but if you're expecting anything premium you'll be let down. Not terrible, just underwhelming.

Ordered this on a Tuesday and it showed up at my door Thursday morning, way faster than the estimated delivery. The box was sealed tight in bubble wrap and an outer cardboard sleeve, no dents or crushed corners anywhere. Honestly the packaging was better than some brand new laptops I've bought retail. Pulled it out and the thing looked practically untouched, not a single scratch on the aluminum. Booted up in maybe fifteen seconds and the screen is gorgeous, super crisp and bright. Keyboard feels solid with that nice clicky feedback. I was a little nervous spending this much online but the whole experience was smooth start to finish. Been using it for about a week now for photo editing and it hasn't stuttered once. Really happy with this purchase.

Bought this to replace a dead Netgear that kept dropping signal every few hours. Setup took maybe ten minutes through the browser interface, and I had all three of my smart TVs, two phones, and a gaming PC running with zero lag. The 5GHz band handles 4K streaming like a champ, and I'm getting full speed in every corner of my 1800 sq ft house. Even the backyard gets a solid signal now, which wasn't happening before. The USB port is a nice touch, plugged in an old external drive and now the whole family can access it over the network. If you're working from home, streaming constantly, or just tired of dead spots, this is the one to get. Easily worth the money and then some.

Needed a backup power supply for my home office setup and didn't want to spend APC money, so I took a chance on this Tripp Lite. Glad I did. For what this costs, you're getting a solid unit that handles my desktop, dual monitors, and router without breaking a sweat. We had a quick power flicker last week and everything stayed on, no reboot, no lost work. The outlets are nicely spaced so bulky transformers don't block adjacent plugs, which is a small detail but matters. Software is basic but gets the job done for graceful shutdowns. Knocking off one star because the unit is heavier than expected and the power button feels a little cheap. Otherwise, hard to beat at this price point. Would buy again for my next build.

Bought these to get a wired connection to my smart TV and Blu-ray player in the living room since my WiFi router sits in a back bedroom. The wireless signal back there was passable but streaming 4K content kept buffering, especially in the evenings. Setup took maybe five minutes total, just plugged one unit near the router, connected the ethernet cable, then plugged the second one behind my entertainment center. I'm getting noticeably better throughput than WiFi, and movie streams load almost instantly now. Knocking off a star because the units run pretty warm and they're bulky enough to block the adjacent outlet on my power strip, which was annoying to work around. Still, for the price, these solved my streaming headaches without fishing ethernet cable through walls.

Replaced an aging Onkyo with this Denon and the difference is night and day. Setup was surprisingly painless, the on-screen GUI walks you through everything step by step, and Audyssey nailed the EQ on my first try. I'm running a 5.1 setup with some older Klipsch towers and a BIC sub, and the soundstage is incredibly wide and clean. Movies have real punch now, and music sounds warm without being muddy. The networking features are great too, streaming Spotify directly through the receiver without needing my phone as a middleman is super convenient. The remote is cluttered but honestly I use the app most of the time anyway. Runs cool, no weird handshake issues with my LG OLED. Really happy with this purchase overall.

Was hesitant at first because of the size and the fact that it's not really meant to be tossed in a bag, but honestly that's the only downside. For what you pay, the sound quality is ridiculous. I've got buddies who spent triple on name-brand setups and they're shocked when they hear this thing fill my living room. Bass is punchy without muddying up the mids, and the highs stay crisp even at higher volumes. It's not featherlight, sure, but I just leave it on the shelf and move it room to room when needed. The Bluetooth range is solid too, I can walk to the kitchen with my phone and it never drops. If you want big, room-filling audio without emptying your wallet, just get it.

Ordered these directly from the manufacturer's site and honestly wish I hadn't. The shipping box arrived looking like it got dropped down a flight of stairs. Both corners were crushed and when I opened it up, the inner packaging was even worse. Styrofoam pieces were shattered everywhere, and there was a weird chemical smell coming from the box itself. Pulled the speakers out and the left satellite had a visible scuff on the side plus a loose grille that rattles when you tap it. The wiring situation is an absolute mess too, spent twenty minutes just untangling everything before I could even think about hooking it up. For something with a THX badge and this price point, I expected way better quality control. Already started the return. Wouldn't recommend.

Been using this webcam daily for almost eight months now for work calls and streaming, and it's held up amazingly well. I've knocked it off my monitor probably a dozen times onto a hardwood floor and there's not a scratch on it. The mount still grips tight and the lens hasn't picked up any weird fogging or dust issues internally. Picture stays crisp at 1080p even in my dim office lighting, and the autofocus is quick without that annoying hunting back and forth. Audio through the built in mic is clean enough that I stopped using my separate one. My old camera from a different brand died after like four months so I was nervous spending the money, but this thing is built like a tank. No regrets at all.

Picked this up to keep my 2.5" portable drive from bouncing around loose in my backpack. The shell is definitely rigid, gave it a squeeze and there's zero flex, which is exactly what I wanted. Inside, there's a foam insert that holds my WD My Passport snug with no rattling. My only minor gripe is the mesh pocket on the lid is pretty tight, so stuffing a short USB-C cable in there takes some effort. Still, it closes fine without bulging. Dropped my bag pretty hard on pavement last week and the drive inside didn't skip a beat. For the price, I'm genuinely impressed. Knocked off one star because the zipper feels a little sticky out of the box, hoping it loosens up with use. Solid buy overall.

Took this camera on a three-week trip through Iceland last summer and it survived everything I threw at it. Got caught in a downpour near Skogafoss, dropped it on some volcanic rock, and it still fires up every single time without issue. The body has a solid, weather-sealed feel that gave me confidence shooting in rough conditions. Image quality is sharp and the autofocus locks on quickly even in low light. My only complaint is the viewfinder feels a bit cramped compared to higher-end models, and the rear screen could be brighter for sunny shooting. Battery life is decent but not great, so grab a spare. Eighteen months of heavy use later and nothing has quit on me yet. Solid purchase.

Honestly didn't expect much for the price but this charger completely blew me away. My original Samsung cable started acting up after about six months, slow charging, loose connection, the usual. I figured a replacement would either be the same flimsy quality or some cheap knockoff that barely works. This one charges my S6 just as fast as the factory one did brand new, maybe even quicker. The cable feels way thicker and more solid too, like it'll actually survive being shoved in a bag. Fit is nice and snug in the port, no wiggling. I've had it about three weeks now with zero issues. Definitely exceeding what I paid for it. Already thinking about grabbing a second one for the office.

I've had this body for about four years now and it's taken an absolute beating. Dropped it on rocks while hiking, got caught in heavy rain more times than I can count, and it still fires up every single shoot without hesitation. The weather sealing on this thing is no joke. I pair it with my DA Limited primes and the image quality still impresses me even compared to newer bodies my friends shoot with. Battery life is solid, autofocus is quick enough for most situations, and the controls feel as good today as they did unboxing it. The shutter count on mine is well past 30k and nothing has needed servicing. If you want a rugged body that just refuses to quit, grab one. Best camera purchase I've made.

Needed a basic keyboard for my home office after my fancy mechanical one started double-typing. Picked this up on a whim and honestly it's been perfect. The keys have a satisfying click without being obnoxiously loud, and the layout is standard so there's no learning curve. No weird wrist angles or split designs, just a solid, straightforward keyboard that does exactly what it should. The build feels sturdy too, not flimsy like some budget options I've tried. I'd definitely recommend this to anyone who just wants a reliable, no-frills keyboard for daily typing. Great for office work, school setups, or really anyone tired of overpriced ergonomic models that take weeks to get used to. At this price point, it's hard to beat.

Picked this up on a whim and honestly wasn't expecting much for the price. The stock software is pretty rough, laggy, weird interface choices, and a few pre-installed apps that nobody asked for. Almost returned it the first day. Decided to dig around online and found a pretty active community around this thing. After flashing a custom ROM, the whole experience flipped. Runs smooth, handles streaming and light browsing without issues, and battery got noticeably better too. Build quality is decent for what it is, nothing premium but doesn't feel like it'll fall apart either. Screen looks fine for casual use, though don't expect iPad-level sharpness. Once you get past the software headache, it's actually a solid little tablet. Glad I stuck with it.

Bought this for my kids and ended up binge-watching the whole thing myself. The picture quality on these remastered episodes is surprisingly sharp. Worth every penny.
Andy Griffith playing totally against type is incredible. His raw, unhinged performance blew me away. The musical numbers are surprisingly great too. Glad I bought this.
Solid buddy cop flick with great chemistry between the leads. Grabbed it on sale and definitely worth what I paid. Decent extras too.
Love this series but after watching half the season the disc started skipping badly. Seems like these sets don't hold up well with regular use over time.
Watched this a bunch over six months and the disc still plays perfectly without any scratches. Decent program but pretty short overall.
Arrived quickly and the slipcover was in perfect condition with no dents. Popped in Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla right away and the picture quality blew me away. Great set overall.
Watched this with my kids last weekend and we all loved it. The soundtrack is surprisingly beautiful and had me tearing up more than once.
Absolutely loved this. The storytelling pulls you in right away and doesn't let go. Watched it twice already and still got emotional both times.
Watched this after our San Francisco vacation and the island scenes gave me chills. The suspense holds up incredibly well and the picture quality on this edition is sharp.
Paid way too much for this. The pacing drags and honestly feels like a history lecture. Not worth the price tag at all, skip it.
Bought this for my dad's birthday and we all ended up loving it. Perfect for anyone who enjoys classic westerns with a solid storyline. Definitely worth adding to your collection.
Got this on sale and it was worth every penny. Solid action throughout and the stunts are incredible. Great addition to my collection for the price.
Grabbed this on sale and honestly it's worth every penny. The fight scenes alone justify the purchase. Story gets a little messy but still a solid watch.
Arrived two days early in a sturdy mailer with no cracks. Popped it in right away and the transfer looks surprisingly crisp for such an old film. Really happy with it.
Paid twelve bucks for this? Total cash grab. The plot is a mess and Liam's character is ruined. Not even worth renting. Save your money.
Fantastic season from start to finish. The cast chemistry was incredible and kept me hooked every single episode. Easily one of my top seasons ever.
Case arrived cracked and the disc was rattling around loose inside. There's a scratch right across the middle of it. Skipped through the first ten minutes before freezing completely. Total waste.
Bought this as a gift and everyone loved it. Picture quality is super clear and the case came undamaged. Shipping was fast too. Really happy with this purchase overall.

Expected a wholesome family film but ended up horrified by how the animals were handled throughout. The way livestock was left unattended and neglected onscreen completely ruined what should've been a heartwarming watch.
Grabbed the complete series on sale and it's worth every penny. Still hilarious after all these years. My family binges episodes constantly. Best comedy purchase I've made.
Expected something on par with Summer Wars but this felt way more aimed at a younger crowd. The drama is fine, just not what I was hoping for.
Watched this with my mom and we were both completely blown away. The story of Christy Brown is heartbreaking and inspiring. Beautifully filmed and acted. Left me thinking about it for days.
Arrived two days early in a sturdy bubble mailer with zero damage to the case. Popped it in right away and the picture quality blew me away for a cult horror flick. Super happy with this pickup!
Went in expecting another generic superhero flick but was genuinely surprised. The story feels fresh and unpredictable. Way better than the trailers suggested. Definitely worth watching.
I've had this ballet DVD for about eight months now and it still plays perfectly despite being used almost daily. Great instruction that really holds up over time.
Picked this up on sale and honestly it's worth way more than what I paid. Tons of classic westerns packed together. You'd spend a fortune buying each title separately.
Grabbed this on sale and it's worth every penny. The cases are super engaging and the cast has amazing chemistry. Binged the whole season in two weekends.
Arrived two days early in a sturdy mailer with zero damage to the case. Popped it in right away and the picture quality blew me away. Totally worth every penny.
Watched this with my family last weekend. The storyline holds up well and there are some genuinely funny moments, but certain jokes haven't aged gracefully. Still an okay watch overall.
Picked this up on sale and it's worth every penny. The episodes look great and the extras are a nice bonus. My whole family binged it in one weekend. Definitely grab a copy.
The storyline had potential but the production quality was honestly terrible. Sound kept cutting in and out during key scenes, and the camera work looked like somebody filmed it on a flip phone.
I've watched this Roman Empire series probably five times now and the discs still play perfectly. No scratches or freezing at all. Holds up amazingly well for how often I lend it out to friends.
Picked this up on sale and it was worth every penny. My daughter has watched it probably ten times already. The Scottish setting is gorgeous and Merida is a fun character.

Saw this at a friend's house and had to own it. The performances are incredible and it stays with you for days. Highly recommend it to anyone who appreciates character-driven stories and doesn't mind reading subtitles.

Had this DVD for about a year now and it still plays perfectly despite being watched multiple times. The disc held up way better than I expected. Great Koontz adaptation that holds up to repeat viewings.

Honestly expected to hate this after the messy theater cut, but the extra footage actually fixes a lot of the pacing issues. It's not perfect and still doesn't match the first two, but way more watchable than I anticipated.
Arrived with the case cracked and the disc loose inside, scratched to hell. Stuck it in my player anyway and the picture looked like somebody smeared vaseline on the lens. Total waste of money.

Bought this on a whim and ended up watching the whole thing in one weekend. The writing is sharp and the cast nails every scene. Would definitely recommend to anyone who loves British crime dramas with real depth.

Grabbed this on sale and it's worth every penny. Ethan Hawke delivers, and those old film reels are genuinely creepy. Great sound design too. Solid horror pick for a Friday night without breaking the bank.

Solid WWII thriller with great production design. I really appreciated the attention to period detail in the uniforms and Berlin street scenes. Tom Cruise's performance took some getting used to, but the tension during the bomb scene had me on edge. Worth a watch.

Honestly expected worse based on some of the comments here. Sure, the transfer isn't pristine, grainy and soft in spots, but I've seen far worse from this era. The movie itself is a charming little whodunit with genuine laughs. Glad I took the chance.

I've watched this probably ten times over the past year and the Blu-ray still plays flawlessly. No scratches, no skipping. Neeson and Platt are an incredible duo. Holds up perfectly with repeat viewings. The therapy scenes get funnier every single time.
Really enjoyed this film. The story kept me hooked the entire time and the picture looked sharp on my TV. Watched it with my family and everyone liked it. Glad I rented it, definitely worth the time.

Loved every minute of this. Farrell and Gleeson are perfectly cast as hitmen killing time in a gorgeous Belgian town. If you enjoy British dark humor or anything by Martin McDonagh, you need to watch this immediately. Bought my own copy after renting.

Picked this up on sale and still feel ripped off. The humor just doesn't land for me, and a couple episodes were plain uncomfortable to sit through. Not worth what I paid, honestly. Glad I didn't spend full price on this one.

The battle scenes go on forever and I honestly started checking my phone halfway through. That said, the ending wraps things up nicely and some of the character moments really land. Not bad overall, just way more spectacle than story. Glad I watched it once.

Honestly didn't think the packaging would be this impressive in person. The case feels substantial and every little insert is thoughtfully designed. Way beyond what I expected for the price. My copy had zero damage on arrival. Blade Runner fans, just get it.

Thought this would be another generic yoga disc, but it's genuinely challenging. The pacing is slower than I expected, which actually forces you to engage deeper muscles. I'm way more sore (in a good way) than I get from studio classes. Definitely exceeded what I paid for it.

Honestly figured this would be another annoying kids show I'd end up tolerating. Turns out it's genuinely funny and the songs don't make me want to scream. My four year old is obsessed and I actually catch myself laughing along most days. Totally worth the purchase.

Got the complete box set on sale and honestly it's worth every penny. Hours and hours of top-tier drama, incredible production value, and performances that stick with you. Cheaper than a month of streaming subscriptions and you actually own it. Best entertainment purchase I've made all year.

Didn't expect much from an older animated show, but this complete collection blew me away. The writing holds up incredibly well and the bonus features go way beyond what you usually get. Way better than streaming versions. Only downside is the censored dialogue, but still absolutely worth buying.

Honestly expected this to be another generic animated flick my kids would forget. It's surprisingly well done though. The humor actually landed for me, and my 7-year-old has watched it three times this week. Not a masterpiece, but way better than the usual stuff we sit through.

Bought this a few months back and it's already skipping badly. The disc surface seems incredibly flimsy compared to other DVDs I own. Gets scratched way too easily even with careful handling. Pretty disappointed it didn't hold up longer.

Honestly one of the weirdest films I've ever sat through. The concept had potential but the execution is just messy and uncomfortable. Acting feels amateur and the plot makes zero sense. I kept waiting for it to get better but it never did. Total waste of money.

Honestly expected way more from all the hype. The pacing drags hard in the middle and I kept checking how much time was left. Both leads are fine actors individually but together it just falls flat. Not terrible, just forgettable. Wouldn't really recommend buying this one.

Grabbed this during a sale and honestly it's worth every penny. DeNiro absolutely kills it in this role. The picture quality is solid for an older film and the storyline holds up perfectly. Added it to my collection and already watched twice. Can't beat the price for a classic like this.

Watched this on a lazy Sunday afternoon and honestly enjoyed it more than I expected. Keaton and Douglas are charming even if the story goes exactly where you think it will. Nothing groundbreaking, but sometimes you just want a comfortable, feel-good movie. Grabbed some popcorn and had a nice time.

Got this for my 18 month old son and it's been a game changer. He's already picking up signs and trying to say words he wasn't attempting before. The ladies keep him engaged the entire time. Wish I'd found these DVDs sooner!

Paid twelve bucks for this and honestly regret every penny. The pacing drags horribly and the whole thing feels like a cheap made-for-TV production. Expected way better production quality for the price. Save your cash and just stream something else instead. Total letdown from start to finish.

Watched this on a rainy weekend and was pleasantly surprised. The action sequences are incredibly shot, especially the chase scene about halfway through. Jolie absolutely owns the screen the entire runtime. My only gripe is the twist feels a little rushed near the end, but it didn't ruin the experience. Glad I picked this up.

Watched this on a whim and ended up totally blown away. The pacing pulls you in right from the start and never lets go. McConaughey absolutely nails his role, probably one of his best performances honestly. The story goes places you won't expect. Already recommended it to two friends.

Watched this with my sister last weekend and we had a blast. The soundtrack is honestly the highlight, those classic tracks brought back so many memories. The plot is pretty predictable and cheesy at times, but the musical numbers make up for it. Not a cinematic masterpiece, but a fun nostalgia trip worth your time.

Grabbed this for five bucks and honestly it's worth ten times that. Pop it in, dim the lights, and let Peter Cetera do the rest. Sound quality is surprisingly crisp for the price. Already watched it three times this month. Best cheap purchase I've made all year.

Honestly, I wasn't expecting a cinematic masterpiece, but this was pretty forgettable even for a kids' movie. The talking dog gimmick carries a few scenes, but the storyline drags and the jokes mostly fall flat. My nephew sat through it once and hasn't asked to watch it again. Fine for a rainy afternoon, nothing more.

Grabbed this on Blu-ray for under ten bucks and it's worth way more. Hopkins absolutely nails the role of a hospice worker wrestling with what people face at the end. The extras include a solid making-of featurette too. For the price, you're getting a genuinely powerful indie film that sticks with you long after the credits.

Ordered this on a whim and it showed up two days later in a padded mailer with no cracks or scratches on the case. Popped it in that same night and was hooked within the first ten minutes. Expected a lot more from this given the cast. The plot drags for the first hour and then rushes to tie everything up. Caviezel does what he can with weak material, but even he can't save it. Not terrible, just disappointing compared to what it could've been.

Had this set for about two years now and the discs still play perfectly despite being loaned out multiple times. The packaging has held up well too, no cracked hubs or scratched surfaces. My only gripe is the fourth film's transfer looks a bit soft compared to the others. Solid collection overall for any sci-fi horror fan.

The fight choreography in this series is seriously impressive. Each technique looks like it could work in real life, not just flashy anime nonsense. I picked up a few actual martial arts concepts just from watching. The humor lands perfectly between all the combat scenes. Wish we got another season but what's here is absolutely worth owning.

Finally sat down to binge this after everyone at work wouldn't shut up about it. The cinematography in season four alone is worth the price. Walter White's transformation feels so natural you barely notice it happening until it's too late. Some episodes drag a little in season two but the payoff is huge. Glad I bought the complete set instead of individual seasons.

Not every joke lands and the middle section slows down a bit, but it's way better than I expected going in. Worth a watch if you're into industry satire.
