Honestly didn't expect much for the price but this puzzle feeder completely surprised me. My orange tab is usually lazy and loses interest fast, but he actually works for his kibble now instead of whining at the bowl. The pieces slide smoothly and nothing has gotten stuck yet. Way sturdier than the flimsy ones I've tried before. Hand washes easily too. Genuinely exceeded what I thought I was getting.

My vet suggested adding a probiotic after my cat finished a round of antibiotics that upset her stomach. This powder mixes easily into wet food and she eats it without hesitation. Her digestion has improved and the litter box situation is much better. I'd definitely recommend this to anyone dealing with a cat who has sensitive stomach issues or takes regular medication.

I've been using Urine Gone for about six months now with three cats in the house, and these bottles take a beating. The spray nozzle hasn't clogged once, which surprised me because every other pet stain cleaner I've bought eventually jams up. Still works just as well as day one. The formula itself handles old set-in stains on my hallway carpet that I thought were permanent. Glad I grabbed the full kit.

Switched to these about three months ago after my long-haired tabby was hacking up furballs almost weekly. The difference has been night and day, maybe one minor incident since starting. She treats them like treats and comes running the second I open the cabinet. The crunchy texture seems to be the selling point for her because she turns her nose up at the softer alternatives. Vet recommended and honestly wish I'd tried them sooner.

I've been applying this on my 70lb shepherd for about eight months straight now and it still works just as well as the first dose. We hike through heavy brush every weekend and I've yet to pull a single live tick off her. Even with frequent bathing between applications, the protection holds up solid. Switched from the expensive brand and honestly wish I'd done it sooner. Saved a ton without sacrificing results.

Honestly didn't expect much for the price, but these exceeded every expectation. The bags are way bigger than I thought they'd be, and the smell alone gets my lab mix sprinting across the yard. I break them into quarters for recall practice and they hold up fine in my treat pouch without getting crumbly or gross. The variety pack is smart, I go through the chicken fastest. Will absolutely reorder when I run low.

Arrived two days early in a sturdy box with zero damage. Pulled it out and was immediately impressed by how solid the shell feels, no flimsy vibes at all. The latch mechanism is smooth and the built-in dish on top is a clever touch. Love the soft blue color too. Already loaded it in the car for tomorrow's vet run. Definitely worth every penny.

Arrived quickly in a padded mailer which was nice, though the bag itself had a small puncture near the seal. A couple treats were stale-ish from air getting in but most were fine. My two ragdolls go crazy for these during thunderstorms and I like that the ingredients aren't junk. Would've been five stars if the packaging held up better in transit. Might reorder but will try Subscribe & Save next round.

Bought this for my older beagle who can't jump up on the couch anymore. She took to it right away with zero hesitation. The traction on each step is great and the whole thing feels solid even when she hurries up it. Doesn't take up much space in our living room either. Super easy to assemble in about five minutes. We've been using it daily for three months and it's holding up perfectly.

The concept is neat but execution is just okay. My two adult cats barely use it because the fabric sags too much even when I set it up properly between two kitchen chairs. It feels decent quality for the price and was easy to figure out. One of my cats occasionally naps on it for maybe ten minutes before jumping somewhere else. Not terrible but honestly I expected more interest from them given how much they love regular hammocks and soft spots.

Arrived two days late and the box was practically destroyed. The heater itself was loose inside with zero protective padding, just rattling around. Noticed the glass tube had a small crack right away but figured I'd test it anyway. Big mistake. Plugged it in and absolutely nothing happened, no light, no warmth, nothing. For the price this thing feels incredibly cheap and flimsy. Already requested a return and going with a different brand. Don't waste your time.

For the price, this thing is unbeatable. My cat flings litter everywhere after doing his business, and the tall sides on this contain the mess perfectly. It's sturdy, doesn't slide around when he scratches, and fits nicely in the small bathroom corner. Honestly expected to pay way more for something this solid. Cleanup is a breeze too since there are no weird crevices. Grabbed one for my mom's place too. Highly recommend.

Setup was a workout and the instructions weren't super helpful, but once assembled this thing is solid. Took it on a weekend hiking trip and my cat seemed comfortable inside. The mesh panels give good airflow and the backpack straps are decently padded. My only complaint is the side zippers can be a little sticky. Overall a good buy for the price if you want to take your cat on adventures.

Didn't expect much for the price but figured it was worth a shot. Our beagle was having accidents daily and we were getting frustrated. Set this up in the corner of the yard and within a week she was using it consistently. The treat dispenser works reliably and hasn't jammed once. Honestly would've paid triple for these results. Build quality is solid too, has survived rain and our dog pawing at it constantly. Highly recommend.

Bought these for my golden retriever and they gave him terrible diarrhea within a day. Stopped the treats, issue cleared up. Tried again a week later to be sure, same thing happened. My vet said these are full of fillers and artificial junk that sensitive stomachs can't handle. Also noticed they crumble apart super easily, leaving greasy residue all over my floors. Definitely not worth the premium price tag. Going back to single-ingredient dental chews.

Got these on a whim and honestly the price for the quantity is unbeatable. My golden retriever goes nuts every time I open the bag. They're nice and chewy so I can break them in half for training rewards without them crumbling apart. No tummy issues at all which is huge since she's got a sensitive gut. Way cheaper than the boutique brands at my local pet store and honestly just as good if not better.

Started my rescue kitten on this when she was about six weeks old and she's been on it for four months straight. The texture stays consistent batch to batch and never separates or gets watery, even when I store an opened can in the fridge for a couple days. My cat's growth has been steady and healthy the entire time. No stomach upset ever, and her energy levels are great. This has held up as a reliable daily food without any issues whatsoever.

Got this for my lazy senior cat who ignores most toys, and it actually got him moving. The best part is the motion sensor that wakes it back up when he walks past. I don't have to keep turning it on. Battery life has been solid after two weeks of daily use. Only complaint is it's pretty loud on hardwood floors, but the entertainment value makes up for it. Definitely worth picking up if your cat needs more stimulation.

My 85 pound pit mix usually shreds "indestructible" toys in under an hour. This is the first thing that's actually held up beyond a week. He's obsessed with it and carries it everywhere. Fair warning, it gets rough on the surface after some gnawing sessions, so maybe keep it off hardwood floors if you walk barefoot. If you've got a powerful chewer who goes through everything else, absolutely grab one of these. Totally worth every penny.

Ordered this salmon and sweet potato kibble for my golden who can't tolerate poultry. Bag arrived two days early with zero damage to the packaging, which was a relief since I've had other deliveries show up ripped open. The pieces are a good size for larger breeds and don't have that overwhelming fishy smell I expected. Transitioned over a week with no tummy upset at all. Too early to comment on coat improvements but my picky eater devoured it immediately. Will update after finishing the bag.

My vet quoted me over $500 for a dental cleaning on my senior beagle, so I figured I'd try this first. Sprinkled it on her food twice a day and within about five weeks the brown buildup on her molars was noticeably flaking off. Her breath improved too. I'd absolutely recommend this to anyone with an older dog or a pup that won't let you brush their teeth. Way cheaper than anesthesia and she actually gets excited at mealtime.

Bought two of these for my labrador and they were completely destroyed within 48 hours. The stuffing comes out way too easily and it's a choking hazard if your dog is even slightly curious. My older dog who never chews anything managed to rip a hole in hers the first night. I would only recommend this to someone with a senior dog that barely moves. Otherwise skip it and get something with a tougher cover. Total waste of money for any active breed.

Been using this leash for about two months now and really happy with it. We do a lot of hiking and beach trips, so I needed something that wouldn't soak up water or smell gross after a few outings. This one rinses clean in seconds and dries almost instantly. The clip feels secure and the backup attachment gives me peace of mind when my pup pulls hard on trails. Comfortable to hold too, no rope burn like our old one. Definitely recommend for active dogs.

Bought this to keep my two cats off the kitchen counters and it worked fine for about a week. After that the adhesive started collecting dust and fur until it was basically useless. The strips curled up at the edges and my cats figured out they could just push past them. I cleaned the surface properly before applying too. For the price I expected something that would hold up longer than seven days. Total waste of money honestly. Looking into motion sensor sprays instead.

Ordered this for my crested gecko and was nervous about glass shipping, but it arrived double-boxed with foam corners and not a single scratch. Unpacking it, the first thing I noticed was how sturdy the frame feels and the front doors open and close really smoothly. The screen top fits snug and the cable pass-through on the back is a nice touch. Way better quality than the cheap tanks at my local pet store. Super impressed right out of the box.

Arrived two days early with zero dented cans, which is honestly rare for a heavy order like this. Every lid was intact and the labeling looks clean and professional. Popped one open for my lab's dinner and the smell is actually appetizing instead of that gross pate odor you get from cheap brands. You can see real shredded chicken in there, not just mush. She devoured the whole bowl in under a minute and sat by the pantry waiting for more. Already reordered a bigger pack.

I really wanted to love this seat cover because the printed dog pattern is adorable and fits my car interior nicely. The waterproof layer works fine for muddy paws and accidental spills. However, the anchor straps are incredibly flimsy. One snapped completely the third time I installed it, and the others stretched out so much that the cover slides around every time my golden retriever jumps in. For the price, I expected heavier duty hardware. It's just okay, but I wouldn't trust it to stay put.

These get the job done for the price. I've gone through about half a box with my medium-sized dog and only had one tear on me during a walk. They fit perfectly in my standard dispenser and the scent is mild, not overpowering. My main gripe is they feel pretty flimsy compared to other brands I've used, so I sometimes double up for messy ones. Overall, an okay budget option if you go through tons of bags and don't want to spend a fortune.

Been buying these for about four months now for my beagle mix. The treats hold up surprisingly well in the pantry without going stale or getting that weird smell some natural brands get after a few weeks. My only gripe is they crumble pretty easily in the bag, so by the time you're halfway through you've got a lot of broken pieces. Dog still loves the crumbs sprinkled over food though. Good quality overall and I keep repurchasing.

Started giving this to my breeding female about three weeks before her expected cycle. The powder coating on the tablets started flaking off almost immediately, and by day five half of them were crumbling apart in the container. Had to mash the broken pieces into wet food just to get a proper dose in her. She did come into heat on schedule, so maybe the formula works, but the packaging quality is honestly terrible for the price. Expected better shelf stability from a supplement this expensive.

I've had this mat for about six months now and it's held up surprisingly well. No tears, no fraying edges, even with my 16-pound tabby digging like a maniac every single day. The material is genuinely tough. That said, it only catches maybe half the litter my cats track out. The rest still ends up scattered across my hallway. I shake it out weekly and it rinses clean easily, which I appreciate. Decent product, just wish the tracking control was a bit better for the price.

Got this for my pit mix who usually shreds plush toys before dinnertime. The squeaker box in the middle is obnoxious but still working after a solid week, which honestly shocked me. Yes, he ripped the stuffing out of both ends pretty quickly, but he carries the empty carcass around everywhere now and actually plays with it instead of ignoring it like most toys. I'd recommend this specifically for medium-to-large dogs who are aggressive chewers but not full-on destroyers. For the price, worth trying.

Switched my itchy lab mix over to this about four months ago after struggling with constant scratching and flaky patches. The difference is honestly night and day. Her coat feels soft again and the redness around her belly completely cleared up. I was spending way too much on boutique brands that didn't even help, so finding something reasonably priced that actually delivers is a huge relief. I'd absolutely recommend this to anyone dealing with a dog that has grain sensitivities or skin issues. Vets should be suggesting this stuff honestly.

Got this for my two kittens and they absolutely love it. The height is perfect and the scratching posts get a ton of use already. Putting it together took maybe thirty minutes by myself. Most pieces fit without any struggle but I did have to muscle the hammock piece into place since the pre-drilled holes didn't line up great. Once assembled it's sturdy enough for my little guys jumping around like crazy. The faux fur covering is softer than I expected and vacuums clean easily. Wish that one section fit better but overall a solid purchase.

For ten bucks this is honestly the best chew toy I've bought my lab in years. He destroys everything within days usually but this thing has survived four months of constant gnawing and there's barely a scratch on it. Yeah it's heavy and makes a thud when dropped on hardwood but that's because the material is actually solid. My guy loves carrying it around the yard and it keeps him busy for ages. Way better than paying thirty dollars for something that gets shredded in an afternoon. Buying another one just to have a backup.

Honestly thought this would be a game changer for my senior cat during winter. The heating element is pretty weak, it barely gets lukewarm even after being plugged in for hours. My cat used it maybe twice and then went back to sleeping on a regular blanket folded on the couch. The mat itself is decent quality and easy to wipe clean, and the cord is nicely protected with the chew-resistant covering. But if your cat runs warm or expects real heat, this falls short. Not terrible for the price, but I wouldn't buy it again. Three stars because it works, just not great.

Honestly didn't expect much from these considering how cheap they are, but my golden retriever has been absolutely obsessed. Most plush toys last maybe two days before they're destroyed and stuffing is everywhere. These have held up way better than anything else I've bought. The squeakers being in the limbs is actually genius because even when she punctures one, the rest of the toy still works fine. We got the giraffe and the elephant. Both still intact after a month of daily fetch and tug sessions. Definitely stocking up on more.

Arrived two days earlier than estimated and came in a compact, resealable bag which was a nice surprise. The harness feels well-made out of the box, sturdy buckles, thick webbing, and no weird chemical smell like some other gear I've ordered online. I got the medium for my border collie mix and the fit was pretty spot on right away. The front clip sits nicely on her chest without shifting around during our first test walk around the block. Still figuring out the best way to adjust the shoulder straps so they don't rub, but overall really solid first impression for the price.

These replacement cartridges are a solid deal compared to buying them at the big chain pet stores. I run two aquariums and go through a lot of them, so finding an affordable bulk option saves me a ton of money. They fit my filter perfectly and the mesh is sturdy enough that it doesn't fall apart after a few weeks like some off-brands I've tried. The water stays crystal clear and my fish are happy. Definitely recommend stocking up if you have a tank that takes this size. Will be ordering again for sure.

Arrived two days earlier than expected in a sturdy cardboard box, no crushing or bending at all. The felt strip was neatly coiled inside a clear sleeve with the wand fully intact. Honestly, the material feels way more durable than I expected for the price. Nice and long, with a slight stretch that gives it good movement right out of the package. My tabby spotted it before I even got the wrapper off and was already swatting. First evening with it went great. No loose threads or weird chemical smell either. Solid first impression overall.

Bought this hoping it would handle the flea problem my two cats picked up. Followed the directions exactly and used it for a full three weeks with zero improvement. The fleas were completely unfazed. I'd only recommend this to someone who wants to waste money on a product that does absolutely nothing. If you have a real infestation, skip this and look elsewhere. Total waste of time and I ended up tossing it in the trash because returning it wasn't worth the hassle. Really disappointed because the reviews made it sound like it actually worked. My vet ended up recommending something else that did the job in days.

Got this for my senior lab who was starting to struggle bending down to eat. The elevated design has made a huge difference for his digestion and he doesn't cough after meals anymore. What I really love is the rubber ring around the base. My dog is a messy eater and used to push his old dish all over the kitchen floor. This thing stays completely put even when he gets excited. The bowls are deep enough to hold a generous serving of food without spilling over the sides. Cleanup is simple since the whole thing is molded plastic with no seams where gunk can build up. Wish I'd switched years ago.

Used this for about three months before it completely fell apart. The mesh on the top already has a huge tear where my cat clawed through it, and one of the seams along the bottom is splitting open. The fabric feels thin and cheap compared to other carriers I've owned. Even the shoulder strap clip started getting stiff and difficult to snap into place after just a few weeks. I expected this to last way longer given the price point. Now I'm shopping for a replacement because I don't trust this thing to hold up during a vet visit. Save yourself the headache and spend a little more on something sturdier.

Bought this for my 40 gallon planted tank about six months ago and honestly couldn't be happier. The setup took maybe ten minutes tops, and I love that you can adjust the flow rate depending on what stock you're keeping. My betta and tetras don't get blasted by current anymore. Cleaning is a breeze too, just pop the top off and rinse the sponges in tank water during weekly changes. What really sold me though is how silent this thing runs. My old HOB sounded like a waterfall and this one I genuinely forget is even running. Water stays crystal clear and my parameters have never been more stable. Highly recommend for anyone upgrading from a basic cartridge filter.

My senior boxer has missing teeth and most treats are too hard for him to manage. These soft chews are perfect because he can actually gum them down without struggling. I was worried they'd be crumbly and make a mess, but they hold together well in the bag and only break apart when you snap them. I like cutting them into quarters for training rewards since they're easy to portion. The smell is pretty strong but that's probably why my dog goes absolutely nuts whenever I reach for the cabinet. We've gone through three bags already and I just subscribed to regular deliveries.

Got this for my golden retriever and it lasted about two weeks before she ripped a hole in the seam and pulled all the stuffing out. That said, my sister's older lab who is way gentler with toys has had the same one for a month now and it's still completely intact. If your dog is a soft chewer or just likes carrying plushies around without really gnawing on them, this is perfectly fine. But anyone with an aggressive chewer should probably look elsewhere because those seams give out pretty fast under real pressure. Decent toy for the right dog.

I've had this car seat for about six months now and it's holding up great. My 12 pound Shih Tzu loves it and immediately took to riding in it. The fabric hasn't frayed at all despite her scratching at the sides when she gets excited. The buckles and clips are still going strong with no signs of wear. I drive a Honda CR-V and the strap fits around my seat perfectly with no slipping. The interior pad has survived multiple washes without losing its shape or getting lumpy. She can easily see out the windows now and seems way more relaxed on long trips. Honestly worth every penny for how sturdy this thing has proven to be over time.

The ball arrived in a box way too big for it with barely any padding, so it was just rolling around loose during transit. There were some minor scuffs on the surface right out of the package which was annoying for a brand new item. First impression is that the material feels solid enough, I'll give it that. But honestly it's way heavier and more rigid than I expected. My German Shepherd couldn't get her mouth around it properly and just batted it with her paws for maybe ten minutes before walking away completely bored. Been sitting in the corner of the yard untouched for three weeks now. Disappointing purchase overall, especially considering what these cost. Wouldn't really recommend unless your dog is massive.

Picked this up for my 70-pound pit mix who pulls like a freight train. For the price, honestly can't beat it. I was looking at pricier harnesses but decided to try this first and glad I did. Took about a week for him to stop trying to rub his face on everything, but now he walks fine. The control is night and day compared to a regular collar. My only complaint is the nylon feels a little thin where it loops under the chin, so I'm not sure how it'll hold up long term with a strong dog. For under fifteen bucks though, it does exactly what it claims. Way better than spending forty on a fancy harness that does the same thing.

Arrived two days early in a massive box with zero damage. Everything was wrapped tight in bubble wrap and the cardboard corners were reinforced. Honestly the best packaging I've seen on a pet order. Assembly took maybe ten minutes and all the hardware was sorted in little labeled bags so nothing got mixed up. The moment I had it together both my cats ran over to investigate. My larger guy immediately jumped on top and it didn't wobble at all. The sisal posts feel super sturdy and the carpet is way softer than I expected. Way better quality than the overpriced one I sent back last month. Super impressed right out of the box.

Honestly expected these to be way cuter and more functional than they actually are. The concept is great, my poodle hates bright sunlight on walks, but the execution falls flat. The brim is stiff and sits at an odd angle that doesn't really block much. It also shifts around constantly no matter how tight I fasten it. My dog tolerates hats generally, but kept shaking this one off within minutes. Material seems okay for the price, nothing impressive. I thought based on the photos it would stay put better and actually provide some real shade coverage. Disappointing overall. Probably fine for a quick photo op but not practical for daily use. Would not purchase again.

My labrador mix goes through toys like nothing else, so I was skeptical about these. Turns out the squeaker is the real winner here. Most squeaky toys lose their noise after a day or two, but these have lasted almost three weeks and still make plenty of sound. The felt covering is way more durable than actual tennis balls too, no bald spots or tearing yet. My dog carries one around the house constantly and even sleeps with it. I bought the pack of six and honestly could've just gotten two because they last so long. They bounce really unpredictably which drives my dog crazy in the best way. Only complaint is they pick up dirt outside pretty fast, but a quick rinse fixes that. Will definitely reorder.

Package arrived two days earlier than expected, which was great since my indoor cat somehow managed to pick up fleas last week. The box was sealed properly and nothing was damaged or leaking inside. Each tube was individually foil-wrapped and easy to snap open. Application was straightforward, parted the fur at the back of her neck and squeezed it on. She didn't flinch or try to run off, so seems like no strong odor or burning sensation. It's only been three days but she's already scratching way less and I've found a couple dead fleas where she sleeps. Knocked off one star because the tube felt a little underfilled compared to what I'm used to, but so far it's doing the job at a fair price.

Ordered the medium for my 30 lb border collie and it arrived two days earlier than expected, which was a nice surprise. Packaging was just a simple clear bag inside a padded mailer, nothing fancy, but the collar itself looked great straight out of the package. No weird chemical smell like I've gotten with other cheap collars. The stitching seems solid and the buckle clicked together firmly. My only minor complaint is the bell is a bit louder than I anticipated, so I might end up removing it for indoor use. Fit my dog's neck perfectly using the sizing chart though, and the material feels like it'll hold up well to daily wear. Overall pretty happy with this purchase for the price.

Got this for my Australian Shepherd mix who loses her mind every time the mail truck shows up. Three months in and it's still going strong despite her rolling in dirt, swimming in the creek, and general roughhousing. The strap hasn't frayed and the contact points still work fine even with all the mud she gets into. Battery lasts about a week before needing a charge which is decent. Knocked off a star because the charging port cover is flimsy and I can tell it'll eventually tear off. Otherwise solid construction. She figured out quickly that quiet means no beep and now I barely need to use it past the warning tone. Wish I'd bought one sooner honestly.

Picked this up for my two cockatiels and honestly can't believe the price point for what you get. The bar spacing is perfect and the whole thing feels way sturdier than I expected. My birds went straight to the top perches and seem genuinely happy with all the space. Yeah the instructions are basically useless and none of the panels have stickers or anything, so plan on spending maybe an hour figuring it out by looking at the pictures. Once you get the first two sides connected it goes pretty quick though. The seed guards around the bottom actually do their job which is a nice surprise compared to my last cage. Door latches feel secure. For the money this is honestly hard to beat. Would definitely buy again.

Got this for my two adult cats and they took to it pretty quickly. Assembly took maybe twenty minutes, instructions were straightforward and all the hardware was included. The structure feels sturdy enough, even when my heavier boy launches himself at the top tier. Both of them love the higher perch for watching birds out the window. What kept it from being five stars is that the interior of the cubbies is just raw plywood with no cushioning or lining. I ended up cutting some old fleece blankets to fit, which solved the problem, but for the price I expected that to be included. The rope on the posts is holding up well to scratching so far. Overall a solid purchase that I'd recommend with that one caveat.

Really glad I bought this little chart. We were constantly second-guessing ourselves on whether the pup had been fed breakfast or dinner, and this solved that problem instantly. The sliding magnets are smooth and feel like they'll hold up well over time. My only real gripe is the adhesive strips that come with it. I followed the instructions exactly, cleaned the wall, let it set, and within two days the whole thing came crashing down. Ended up using my own command strips and it's been totally fine since. The board itself is good quality for the price and the size is perfect, not too bulky but easy enough to read from across the laundry room. Would definitely recommend, just plan ahead and skip the included tape.

I had high hopes for this litter mat based on the product photos, but honestly it falls way short of what's advertised. The honeycomb pockets are nowhere near deep enough to actually trap granules the way the listing suggests. My cat steps right over it and the litter just bounces off onto my floor anyway. For the price, I expected something a lot more heavy-duty. The material feels thin and flimsy, nothing like the thick, durable mat they make it out to be. I will say it's easy to shake clean and doesn't smell weird out of the package, so it's not completely useless. But if you're picturing the magic litter-catching solution from the photos, prepare to be underwhelmed. I've had cheaper mats that performed about the same.

Got this for my two ferrets and honestly impressed right out of the box. Shipping was quick, arrived two days earlier than expected and the packaging was clean, no weird smells or crushed parts like I've dealt with ordering pet stuff online before. The material is surprisingly soft and feels decent quality for the price. It holds its shape well straight away, didn't need any time to "fluff up" or anything. One of my ferrets crawled in within about ten minutes of me setting it down and refused to come out for hours. The other took a little longer but now they take turns. It's roomy enough for one adult ferret to stretch out comfortably. Wish it came in more colors but happy with the purchase overall.

My golden retriever goes absolutely nuts for these. She's about 55 pounds and finishes one in maybe 15 minutes if she really takes her time. Not the longest-lasting treat out there, but she gets so excited when I open the bag that I can't resist grabbing them on my regular pet store runs. The quality seems consistent from pack to pack, though honestly the smell is something you have to get used to. It's not unbearable, just very...distinctive. I'd recommend these specifically to owners of light to moderate chewers who want something their dog will actually get excited about. If your pup is a heavy-duty chewer, you'll probably be disappointed by how fast they disappear. For the price, they're a solid occasional reward.

Ordered this for my two growing labs and it showed up three days earlier than expected, which was a nice surprise. Box arrived without any dents or damage, and everything inside was well-protected with styrofoam corners. Assembly took maybe ten minutes, just unfolded it and clipped the sides into place. The wire feels sturdy enough for normal use, though I wouldn't say it's the thickest gauge I've seen. Plastic tray sits flat and doesn't slide around. My only real complaint is the two-door setup. When you're using the divider for two dogs, accessing both sides is a pain. You basically have to reach across or pull the divider out. Overall though, solid crate for the price. Dogs seem comfortable and it's holding up well after a few weeks.

Ordered two of these for my Golden Retriever and they showed up two days later in a sturdy box with plenty of bubble wrap. No chips or scratches at all, which honestly surprised me because ceramic stuff usually arrives cracked when I order online. Pulled them out and immediately noticed how heavy and solid they feel. The glaze is gorgeous in person, way nicer than the pictures showed. My dog is a sloppy eater and constantly shoved his old plastic bowl across the kitchen floor. Not happening with these. They barely budge even when he gets going. Washed them in the dishwasher last night and they came out perfect. Already thinking about grabbing a second set in a different color for upstairs. Really happy with this purchase overall.

My picky poodle mix usually fights me like crazy when it's dental care time, but she actually tolerates this stuff pretty well. The textured surface is what really sets it apart from other dental products I've tried over the years. It seems to reach those back molars that regular wipes completely miss. After about three weeks of nightly use, I'm noticing way less yellow buildup along her gumline, and her breath has gone from knock-you-over terrible to barely noticeable. My vet had been pushing a costly cleaning under sedation, which terrifies me with her age. I'm really hoping her next checkup shows enough improvement that we can delay that procedure even longer. Worth every penny if you're trying to stay on top of tartar between professional cleanings.

My golden retriever is a serious destroyer of plush toys, so I was skeptical about this little guy surviving more than a day. Three months in and I'm genuinely shocked. The seams are still completely intact even after daily tug sessions and fetch. That belly button sound feature still works perfectly too, which is a miracle considering how many times it's been slobbered on and left in the yard overnight. The fur has pilled up a bit and it's definitely seen better days aesthetically, but structurally this thing is a tank. My dog goes absolutely bonkers whenever it starts making that dramatic groaning noise. We've bought a backup already just in case they ever stop making them. Easily the best toy purchase I've made for her this year.

Switched my two dogs over to this after reading good things about the ingredients. They seemed to like the taste alright, but man, this stuff is pricey for what you actually get. The bag is smaller than I expected and at the rate my labs go through food, I'd be spending almost double what I was paying before. Honestly, I don't mind paying more for quality, but the kibble size is pretty inconsistent and there's a ton of crumbled dust at the bottom of the bag. For the premium price tag, the packaging feels cheap too and the zip seal ripped after the first use. My dogs' coats look okay but not noticeably different from the cheaper brand we were using before. Expected better for the money.

I've been using this deshedding tool for about eight months now on my golden retriever and it still works just like the day I got it. The blade hasn't dulled at all despite weekly use, and the handle hasn't cracked or loosened up like other cheap ones I've tried. My dog hates being brushed but actually sits still for this thing because it doesn't pull or snag. I can fill up a whole grocery bag of fur in one session, no joke. My wife thought I was exaggerating until she tried it herself and couldn't believe how much came off. For what this costs compared to the big name brands, it's a no brainer. Genuinely the best pet purchase I've made in years and it's held up perfectly.

Switched my two mini lops over to this from a cheaper brand and the difference is night and day. Their coats are noticeably shinier after about three weeks, and honestly there's way less waste. With the old stuff they'd pick through and leave half the bowl, but they clean this one up completely every single time. What I really appreciate is the pellet consistency. They're uniform and don't crumble into dust at the bottom of the bag like I've dealt with before. The bag seals well too, which keeps everything fresh. One thing, my rabbits go absolutely bonkers for the little colored bits mixed in, almost to the point of being obsessed. Wish I could buy those separately as treats. Overall a solid upgrade and I'll keep repurchasing.

Honestly didn't expect much for the price but this leash has been a pleasant surprise. I've got a 55lb mutt who pulls hard on walks and this thing handles him no problem. The grip is surprisingly comfortable - way better than the cheap plastic ones I've had before that hurt my hand after ten minutes. The lock mechanism works smoothly, no jamming or sticking like my last retractable. The built-in light is brighter than I thought it would be, actually useful for evening walks and not just a gimmick. Only downside is you need your own AAA batteries but that's pretty standard. Four meters gives my dog enough room to explore without feeling like I've lost control. Been using it daily for three weeks now with zero issues. Definitely recommend.

Arrived two days earlier than expected in a sturdy box with the harness secured inside a resealable bag, nice touch. Pulled it out and immediately noticed how thick the padding is around the chest and shoulders. The stitching looks way more heavy-duty than the cheap one I bought at PetSmart last year. Hardware feels solid too, none of that flimsy plastic buckle nonsense. I ordered a large for my 75-pound pit mix and the fit is spot on right out of the package with room to adjust. The front clip is a game changer for leash training, he still gets excited but no more dragging me down the sidewalk. Only had it a week but so far zero signs of wear. Will update after a few months of daily use.

Finally solved the dehydration problem with our picky orange tabby. He used to follow us into the bathroom every single time, crying at the sink. This fountain changed that almost immediately. Setup took maybe five minutes, snap the pieces together, fill, plug in. The water flow is smooth and quiet, just a gentle trickling sound that doesn't bother us at all. What I really appreciate is how easy it is to take apart for cleaning. The top lifts right off and everything rinses out quickly. We've been running it for about three weeks now and the filter is still going strong. Our cat drinks way more than he used to and his coat actually looks better. Worth every penny if you have a stubborn drinker.

I was honestly pretty skeptical about lightweight litter since the last brand I tried tracked everywhere and smelled awful. This one actually surprised me. It's maybe a third of the weight of the standard stuff, which my back appreciates when hauling it up the stairs. Clumping is decent, not rock solid like the original formula, but it holds together well enough that I'm not losing half the pan every time I scoop. Dust is way lower than I expected. There's a tiny bit when you first pour it, but nothing like the cloud I'd get from the regular stuff. Scent control is fine for my two cats. My only real gripe is it seems to get used up a bit faster. Still, I'll keep buying it.

I've had this prong collar for about eight months now and it's still going strong. My 85-pound German Shepherd mix used to absolutely drag me down the street every single walk. Tried harnesses, front-clip ones, gentle leaders, nothing worked. Within two days of using this, he was walking right beside me like a different dog. What really impresses me is the build quality. We walk twice daily on pavement, through rain and dirt, and there's zero rust or weakening in the links. The chrome finish has held up way better than I expected. Still clicks securely every time. My only advice is to size it properly, I had to remove two links for a snug fit. Worth every penny if you've got a strong puller.

The box showed up completely crushed on one side and half open, honestly surprised the post office even delivered it like that. There was zero padding inside, just the carrier stuffed in a thin plastic bag. When I pulled it out, the stitching along the top seam was already coming undone and there were weird dark smudges on the fabric like it had been sitting on a warehouse floor. The zipper felt super flimsy right out of the gate, like it would skip teeth if you looked at it wrong. I didn't even bother putting my cat in it. For thirty-something bucks I expected way better. Requested a return the same afternoon. Wouldn't trust this thing to hold up past one trip, let alone keep my pet secure.

Expected a lot more from this heater based on the description. I set it up in my 40 gallon turtle enclosure and right out of the box the temperature reading was all over the place. It would show 80 degrees one minute and then jump to 72 the next without actually heating the water consistently. My turtle seemed stressed from the fluctuations so I ended up swapping back to my old reliable aquarium heater. For the price I honestly thought this would be a solid upgrade but it feels cheaply made and the suction cups barely hold onto the glass. The digital display is nice in theory but pointless if the actual heating element can't maintain a steady temperature. Really disappointing given what was advertised.

My golden retriever is absolutely obsessed with this ball. I've spent a fortune on toys that claim to be tough, and most of them are shredded within an afternoon. This one has actually held up to his relentless chewing and fetching for over two months now with zero signs of damage. The material has a nice give to it so he can comfortably grip it, but it doesn't puncture when he bites down hard. It bounces in unpredictable directions which keeps him entertained for ages in the backyard. Honestly the best dog toy purchase I've made in years. Even my neighbor asked where I got it after seeing how much fun my dog has with it during our daily fetch sessions. Worth every penny.

Honestly expected better from this heater given the price tag and all the hype. It held my 29 gallon tank steady around 80 degrees for the first couple months, which seemed great. But then I noticed the temperature started creeping up randomly. Checked it with a separate thermometer and the tank was at 86 when I had it set for 78. The dial feels super flimsy and honestly I don't trust the suction cups either, one broke within the first week. It's not a terrible heater if you're on a budget and keep a close eye on things, but I definitely wouldn't rely on it for anything sensitive. I ended up buying a backup heater from a different brand just in case this one goes haywire again.

My two labs absolutely inhale this stuff every single morning. I mix a spoonful into their regular kibble to make breakfast more exciting, and one can lasts me about four days that way. For the quality you're getting, the price per can is honestly unbeatable compared to the fancy brands at my local pet store. The texture is soft and shreds easily with a fork, so it blends right in without any weird chunks they try to spit out. I've been buying this consistently for about three months now and neither dog has had any stomach issues or turned their nose up at it. Subscribe and save makes it even cheaper. Definitely recommend if you want to treat your pup without going broke.

Arrived two days earlier than estimated, which was a nice surprise. Box was in decent shape with no crushing, and the seat itself came vacuum-sealed in plastic. Once I opened it and let it expand for about an hour, it puffed right up to full size. Initial impressions are solid, the frame feels sturdy and the fabric is thicker than I expected for the price. No weird chemical smell out of the package either, which I was worried about. My 9-pound terrier took to it pretty quickly on our first test ride. Knocked off one star because the installation straps felt a little thin and I'm not sure how they'll hold up long-term. Overall happy with the purchase though, especially for what I paid.

It does the job and keeps the smell down, which is the main reason I bought it. The sweeping mechanism is surprisingly quiet compared to what I expected, and my two cats adjusted within a week. That said, the waste bin compartment is way too small for my liking. If I forget to empty it for two days, it backs up and the rake drags clumps through clean litter, leaving a mess. I also wish the ramp attachment was sturdier, it wobbles every time my heavier cat steps on it. For the price, I expected better build quality on the accessories. It's not a bad unit overall and saves me from scooping daily, but you'll need to stay on top of maintenance more than the marketing suggests.

Been buying these for about six months now and my cat goes absolutely bonkers every time I open the bag. She hears the crinkling from across the house and comes sprinting. What I really appreciate is that they're not just empty treats, her breath has noticeably improved since we started using them daily, and her vet even commented on how clean her back teeth looked at her last checkup. The texture is key because she actually has to chew them instead of just swallowing whole like she does with everything else. A little pricey compared to basic treats, but honestly worth every penny for the dental benefit alone. My only complaint is the bags could be bigger because we go through them fast. Highly recommend for picky cats.

Got this for my 8-month-old lab who pulls like a freight train on walks. Needed something to work on recall without him bolting completely free at the park. The length is perfect for giving him room to roam while I still have control. Clip feels solid, no worries about it snapping if he hits the end hard. Material has held up great through mud, rain, and plenty of chewing attempts. Washes off easy with a hose. Honestly the stitching is better than leads costing twice as much. I'd recommend this to anyone doing off-leash training with a bigger breed or a stubborn puller. My trainer actually asked where I got it after seeing it in our session last week. Already ordered a second one to keep in the car.

I've been giving this supplement to my two ferrets for about three years straight now, and it's held up amazingly well. The tablets don't crumble or go stale even months after opening the jar, which was a problem I had with a different brand before switching. I just keep the lid snapped shut and they stay fresh the whole way through. My oldest ferret is almost seven and still acts like a kit, bouncing around and eating like a champ. His fur stayed thick and soft through the last couple of winter sheds too. Honestly wasn't sure a vitamin could make that much of a difference, but after seeing the change long-term I'm completely sold. Already on my fourth or fifth reorder and won't be switching to anything else.

Bought this cot for my 60lb mutt about eight months ago and it's still going strong. He's a chewer and a digger, so I was nervous, but he took to it immediately and hasn't tried to destroy it once. The frame is solid metal and the fabric hasn't sagged at all even though he sleeps on it every single night. I keep it on the patio through rain and heat, and honestly it looks almost brand new. Setup took maybe ten minutes, and the feet don't dig into my pavers like other beds I've tried. Worth every penny compared to the cheaper ones I've replaced twice in one year. Finally found something that lasts.

Wish I could get my money back. Transitioned my two labs slowly over two weeks like you're supposed to, and by day ten both were having awful loose stools. Called my vet and she told me to stop immediately. Even during the transition period, my older dog would literally walk away from the bowl and just sit there staring at me. I tried mixing it with warm water, adding a little plain yogurt, even crumbling treats on top. Nothing worked. The smell is pretty off-putting too, not like normal kibble at all. For the price point I honestly expected way better. Had to throw out almost the entire bag. Going back to our old brand and never looking at this stuff again. Save your cash.

Honestly didn't think these would be much different from the cheap ones I normally grab at the grocery store, but I was wrong. The size is what surprised me most, there's actually plenty of room to work with, even when my Great Dane decides to leave a massive pile. No more struggling to stretch a tiny bag over my hand and hoping nothing touches my wrist. The plastic feels thick enough that I'm not paranoid about rips or leaks, which was a constant issue with the old brand. They open pretty easily too, so I'm not standing there fumbling with them while my dog pulls on the leash. Way better quality than what I expected for the price. Already ordered a second pack to keep in the car.

Picked this up a few weeks back for my two indoor cats and honestly it's been a solid addition to the house. Setup took maybe five minutes and the build quality feels decent for the price point. One of my cats took to it immediately and practically lives on it now. The other one is still a little hesitant but slowly warming up to it. My only minor complaint is that it takes up more floor space than I expected, so check your measurements before ordering. It's held up well so far even with daily use and some pretty rough play sessions. For the money, I think it's a fair deal. Not perfect but definitely worth considering if your cats need something to keep them busy. Would probably buy again.

I wasn't sure what to expect for the price, but this crate seriously overdelivered. I needed something for my new mini dachshund pup and figured I'd have to spend way more to get a decent setup. The metal feels way sturdier than I anticipated, none of that flimsy wobbling I've seen on cheaper knockoffs. The latch slides smooth and actually stays put, which was a pleasant surprise. My favorite part is the removable plastic tray. It's thicker than I expected and doesn't slide around every time the dog moves. Setup took maybe three minutes with no tools. Honestly, I was bracing for a janky product at this price point, but it's genuinely well-built. My pup took to it immediately with zero hesitation. Would absolutely buy again.

My two Ragdolls are big boys and most cat trees wobble dangerously when they jump on them. Not this one. The base is incredibly sturdy and the posts are thick enough that even my 15 pounder launching himself at full speed doesn't make it shake. The scratching posts are wrapped really tightly too, which is great because my younger cat is a destructive scratcher and after three months there's barely any fraying. I will say it takes up a serious chunk of my living room, so measure your space before ordering. The top perch is surprisingly roomy and both cats can actually fit up there together, which they couldn't on their old tower. Took me about 45 minutes to build solo. Absolutely worth every penny if you have larger cats.

I've been running this canister on my 75 gallon cichlid tank for about four months now and I'm honestly impressed. Set up took maybe twenty minutes once I figured out the priming. The thing is huge, so make sure you measure your cabinet before buying. Water clarity went from decent to crystal clear within two days of switching it on. I packed the baskets with filter floss, ceramic media, and a coarse sponge, and the flow rate hasn't dropped off at all. My nitrates even seem more stable. The only slight annoyance is the hoses are pretty stiff out of the box but once you get them seated they stay put. For the price point this thing outperforms canisters costing twice as much. Would definitely buy again.

I've been using this treat pouch for about two months now walking dogs daily. The magnetic closure is honestly my favorite part - I can grab kibble one-handed without spilling anything, which matters when you've got a leash in the other hand. That said, the belt clip is a real letdown. It's too loose and pops off my waistband every time I bend over or squat to work with a dog on the ground. I ended up threading my own belt through the loop instead, which works but kind of defeats the point of having a clip at all. The material itself has held fine and wipes clean easily. It's an okay pouch if you can work around the clip situation, but for the price I expected better hardware.

Comes with a little luggage tag-style clip inside for harness attachment which I wasn't expecting. Fit my 11-pound terrier perfectly with room to spare. Haven't taken it on a long trip yet but initial quality is way beyond what I paid. Would absolutely recommend to anyone shopping around.
