My favorite part is how flat it sits in my front pocket, no awkward bulge. Stitching along the edges looks solid so far. Knocked off one star because the cash compartment is a bit narrow, making folding bills slightly annoying. Overall a decent buy for the price.

Honestly I expected this to be more rigid based on the photos, but it's actually fairly flexible and comfortable for all-day wear. The smoothing effect is decent though not as dramatic as I'd hoped. Sizing runs true - I'm a 34C and the medium fit perfectly. Straps don't dig in and the back closure stays put. Wish the bottom band was a bit wider for better tummy control, but overall a solid purchase.

Arrived two days early in a sturdy box with no damage. The canopy material feels thicker than I expected and the handle has a nice grip. Opening mechanism works smooth every time. Only knocked off a star because the auto-close takes some getting used to and the fabric bunches a little when folded up. Overall solid first impression for the price. Happy with this purchase so far.

Honestly didn't expect much for the price but this thing blew me away. I've used it after swims and at the gym for a couple weeks now. It absorbs way better than the microfiber towels I've tried before, and somehow packs down even smaller. The little pouch it comes with is handy for keeping it separate from clothes in my bag. Figured it'd feel cheap but the material seems solid. Genuinely impressed.

Bought this for my recovery and it was decent at first. Comfortable enough and the front closure is handy when you can't lift your arms much. But after about six weeks of wear and washing, the elastic started fraying around the band and one of the seams is coming loose. For the price I expected it to hold up longer. Still wearable but barely. Fine for short-term use but don't count on it lasting.

Ordered this bag for an upcoming trip and it arrived two days early, nicely wrapped in a dust bag inside a sturdy box. No creases or weird chemical smell straight out of the packaging, which was a relief. The hardware looks polished and the leather feels substantial for the price. It's roomy without being bulky on the shoulder. Only knocked off a star because I wish the lining was a bit thicker, but overall a solid purchase so far.

Honestly didn't expect much from a branded suitcase but this completely exceeded my expectations. The floral pattern is even prettier in person and I've gotten compliments at every airport. The spinner wheels glide effortlessly, way smoother than my old Samsonite. Interior pockets are well thought out and it fit a full week of outfits no problem. Feels solid and well-constructed, not flimsy at all. Definitely worth the price.

The channel setting is actually really well done and the stones feel secure, which I appreciated. But the metal color is way off from what's pictured. It's got a dark, gunmetal tone that makes the whole ring look dull and cheap. The CZs have no sparkle at all against it. Really disappointing because the construction quality is there, just ruined by the weird finish. Returning it.

The pendant on this is absolutely stunning in person. The colors are vibrant and the detailing really stands out. I took off one star because the chain feels a little flimsy compared to the pendant itself, and I wish it were a bit thicker. Had to swap it out for one of my own chains. Still, for the price, you are getting a gorgeous statement piece. Already worn it three times this week and gotten several compliments each time.

The lace detail is gorgeous and the band fits true to size, but the cups run a little shallow on me. I don't get quite enough lift, and the straps are positioned a bit wide for my frame. That said, the construction feels solid and it's comfortable for an 8-hour workday. I'd recommend this to women with wider-set breasts and a fuller shape who don't need serious push-up action. Just size up in the cup if you're between sizes.

Got this top for under fifteen bucks and honestly it's worth way more. The fabric is surprisingly soft and has a nice weight to it without being clingy or see-through. I washed it twice now and no shrinking or fading. The fit is true to size, I'm normally a medium and the medium fit perfectly with enough room without looking baggy. Packed it for vacation and it transitioned from beach to dinner easily. Can't beat the quality at this price point.

I expected these to look delicate and elegant based on the photos, but in person they're super bulky. The beaded straps have zero stretch and sit really stiff on top of your foot, so they don't mold or lay flat at all. Every time I walk the whole thing shifts around and the gems dig into my skin. They looked gorgeous in the listing but wearing them is a totally different story. Pretty concept, poor execution. Returned mine after one wear because they were just too uncomfortable.

Got the light blue and the shade is actually really nice, more of a dusty sky tone than what shows on my monitor. Fit through the shoulders is spot on for a medium but the sleeves run about an inch too long for my arms. Fabric has a decent weight to it and doesn't feel cheap like I expected at this price. My main gripe is the buttons, they feel flimsy and one was already loose straight out of the bag. Fine for the price but nothing special.

Really love the feel of this fabric, it's silky without being slippery and doesn't cling at night. The adjustable straps are the highlight for me since I'm tall and usually struggle with short nightgowns riding up. My only complaint is the lace trim along the neckline started fraying slightly after a few washes, even on delicate. Nothing a quick trim couldn't fix though. Fits true to size on me (34B, medium) and the teal color is even prettier in person. Would buy again, just wish the stitching was a bit more reinforced.

Honestly didn't expect much for the price but these completely blew me away. Way more cushioning than I thought I'd get, feels like walking on marshmallows all day. I usually have issues with arch support in flats but these hit all the right spots. Sizing runs slightly snug so I'd suggest going half a size up if you're between. Wore them straight out of the box on a trip with zero blisters. Already eyeing a second color. Way better than the pricier brands I've tried lately.

For the quality you get, these are an absolute steal. I was hesitant at first because the price seemed too good for leather this nice, but they've held up beautifully after three months of daily wear. The sole has great grip and the cushioning is solid for long shifts. I went true to size and had zero issues with the fit. Broke in within a week and now they feel like slippers. Honestly compares to brands costing three times as much. Can't recommend enough.

Honestly didn't expect much for the price but this blew me away. The embroidery is way more detailed in person than the pictures show, you can see every feather on the eagle and the lettering is clean, not cheap looking. Fabric is thick and substantial, not that thin flimsy stuff you usually get. I'm 6'1" 190 and the large fits true to size with enough room for a layer underneath without being baggy. Washed it twice now and no shrinking or fading. Way better than I anticipated.

I've been using this bag daily for about eight months now and it still looks fantastic. I was worried the leather might wear poorly, but it's actually developed a really nice patina and the stitching hasn't budged at all. I regularly stuff it with a camera body, two lenses, and my everyday essentials, and the straps haven't stretched or weakened. It just works as a regular messenger bag that happens to protect my gear. No one ever guesses what's inside. Worth every penny and then some.

Got this for my morning jogs and it's just okay. The support is decent enough for a moderate pace, but I wouldn't trust it for sprints. The band sits a bit weird and tends to roll up after about twenty minutes of movement, which gets annoying fast. On the plus side, the fabric breathes well and doesn't show sweat patches. Straps are easy to tighten but feel flimsy, like they might snap if pulled too hard. Overall it gets the job done, but I've definitely worn better sports bras in this price range.

Came really quick and was wrapped nicely, no weird smells right out of the bag which was a relief. Tried it on immediately and the lift is definitely noticeable under my work slacks. The material feels decent quality for what I paid, not super flimsy like other shapewear I've ordered before. It does ride up slightly when I walk around a bunch but nothing unbearable. Only had it on for a few hours so far so I can't speak to long-term durability yet, but my initial impression is pretty solid overall. Would recommend giving it a shot.

Bought these for a trip to Chicago in January and they handled the freezing wind like a champ. The thermal lining is surprisingly thick without making the gloves bulky, which I was worried about. I could still text and grab my keys without fumbling around. My hands stayed dry even when I got caught in light snow. The leather has a slight sheen to it that looks way more expensive than what I paid. Only thing is they run a touch small, so if you're between sizes definitely size up. Took about a day of wearing them to break in but now they feel like they were made for my hands.

I really wanted to love these for my office job since the waistband is super comfortable and doesn't dig in when I sit all day. That's about the only good thing though. The fabric feels like a cheap paper towel and clings to everything underneath. You can basically see right through them in daylight. I ordered my usual medium and they fit fine around the hips but the legs are bizarrely wide, almost like a bootcut style that isn't shown in the photos. The inseam also runs at least two inches longer than advertised. Disappointing quality for the price.

Arrived tossed in a plain plastic bag with no box, no tissue, nothing. One shoe was crushed flat and the other had a weird crease across the top that won't smooth out. Right out of the bag they looked cheap and flimsy, nothing like the photos. The elastic top section feels stiff and already has a snag running through it. I lifted them up and they weigh almost nothing, like they'd fall apart in a week. Honestly not even worth trying on given the condition they showed up in. Returning immediately. Don't waste your time ordering these.

I've had these water shoes for about eight months now and they've held up surprisingly well. I've taken them on multiple kayaking trips, worn them on rocky riverbeds, and even used them for some light hiking near waterfalls. The soles still have plenty of tread and no signs of separating from the upper. They do collect a bit of sand inside which is annoying but rinses out easily. Sizing was spot on for me. They're not winning any fashion awards but that's not why you buy them. Solid construction for the price point. Would buy again.

Got these for my mom who struggles with lace-up shoes due to arthritis in her hands. They slip right on without any fuss which is exactly what she needed. The lining is incredibly soft and keeps her feet warm during our cold morning walks. I was worried about sizing based on other reviews so I went up a full size and that worked out perfectly. She says they feel like wearing slippers outside. The sole has decent grip for wet pavement too. Honestly anyone dealing with mobility issues or just wanting effortless winter footwear would love these. She wears them daily and they still look great after three weeks of use.

I wasn't sure what to expect for the price, but these seriously exceeded my expectations. The double row of stones gives off just enough sparkle without feeling costume-y. I thought they might look cheap in person, but the setting is actually really well done and the stones catch the light nicely. The half-inch size is perfect, not too tiny, not overwhelming. I've been wearing them daily for about three weeks now and they still look brand new. The clasp is tight enough that I don't worry about losing one, which was a concern of mine. Honestly, they look way more expensive than they actually were. Definitely recommend.

Honestly expected a lot more based on the photos. The fit runs weird, ordered my usual size and the bottom dug in while the top gaped at the sides. Material feels thin and cheap, not like the sturdy swim fabric I was anticipating. Wore it to a pool party and by the end of the afternoon the straps were already stretched out and sagging. The pattern is cute from a distance but up close the print looks blurry and faded. For the price I really thought the quality would be better. It's not unwearable but definitely doesn't live up to what's advertised. Wouldn't buy again or recommend to a friend.

Bought this for my husband after he nearly lost a finger at the gym when his metal band caught on equipment. The stretch on this silicone ring is exactly what we needed. It slides over his knuckle easily but sits snug without rolling around. What surprised me most is how it handles heat, he's a welder and has had no issues with it warping or getting tacky near sparks. The matte finish doesn't show scratches at all, which is wild considering what he puts it through daily. Took maybe two days to break in and now he forgets it's even there. Way better than the rigid plastic one we tried before. Grabbing a backup pair in black next.

Ordered these Tuesday and they landed on my doorstep by Thursday morning, double-boxed and in perfect condition. No crushed tissue paper or weird creases across the toe box. Slipped them on right out of the package and honestly did not want to take them off. The forefoot has this plush, bouncy sensation that hits immediately, and my arches felt locked in without any pressure points. Walked around the kitchen for ten minutes and could already tell these will be my go-to for HIIT days. Super lightweight, almost forgot I was wearing them. The colorway is true to the photos online too, no surprises there. Genuinely impressed with the whole experience so far.

Bought this luggage scale before a big trip to Europe and it actually worked fine for the first couple uses. Got to my destination, weighed my bag on the way back, no problem. Fast forward three months later and I'm packing for another flight and the thing just won't read accurately anymore. It jumps around between 2 lbs and 47 lbs with nothing even hanging from it. I changed the batteries twice thinking that was the issue but nope. The screen also started flickering after barely being tossed around in my drawer. For something that's supposed to travel with you, the build quality is honestly pathetic. It didn't even survive one year of light use. Save your money and get something sturdier.

Got the three-pack in black, grey, and navy and honestly for the price you really can't beat it. These are my go-to throw-on for work and running errands. The fabric is super thin which works great for layering without getting bulky, though I wouldn't count on them keeping you warm in actual cold weather. They wash well too, I've already sent mine through the wash twice and no pilling or shrinking. I ordered my usual size small and the fit is decent, maybe slightly boxy but nothing that bothers me. My arms are on the thinner side so no tightness there. Wish the buttons felt a little sturdier but at this price point I'm not going to complain. Overall a solid buy if you need basic cardigans.

Ordered these for my 7 year old after seeing all the positive feedback. Shipping was quicker than expected and they arrived in a standard shoe box without any damage. First impression out of the box was how solid they feel compared to typical kids sandals. The rubber sole has real grip and the toe cap looks like it will actually hold up to playground abuse. My daughter says they're comfortable right away with no breaking in needed. The adjustable straps are handy since she has one foot slightly wider than the other. Only knocking off one star because the color in person is a bit duller than the photos suggested. Otherwise a solid purchase for summer and I'd order again.

I wanted to like this purse because the design caught my eye right away, but honestly it's been disappointing overall. The material is way too stiff, so fitting anything bulkier than a phone and wallet makes the whole thing bulge out awkwardly. There's zero stretch to it. After about three weeks of normal use, the exterior started scuffing badly and now it looks cheap and beat-up. I haven't been rough with it at all, just regular errands and work. The magnetic closure works fine but the bag itself just doesn't hold up. For the price I expected better durability. It's a shame because the silhouette is genuinely cute, but functionally it's frustrating and I can't recommend it.

The snaps on this thing are an absolute joke. I wore it exactly once and three of them popped off before I even made it to lunch. They're cheaply glued or something instead of actually being attached properly, so any normal movement and they go flying. I managed to snap one back on by forcing the pieces together, but two others were gone for good somewhere on the office floor. The fabric itself feels okay for the price, but what good is a shirt you can't keep closed? I was planning to wear this to a casual dinner this weekend and now I can't because it's literally falling apart at the seams. Returning immediately. Save your money and buy something with real buttons.

Got this for my husband who works private security and he's been wearing it almost every day for the past six months. The thing still looks practically new after dozens of washes. No pilling, no loose threads, no fading at all. He's pretty rough on his clothes too, crawling around, tackling obstacles on the job, and this shirt takes a beating without showing it. The fabric is thick but breathable enough for summer wear. Those concealed chest pockets are honestly genius for stashing a phone or wallet securely. Yeah it stings a little at checkout but I've already replaced cheaper tactical shirts twice in the same timeframe, so do the math. Just ordered a second one in black. Fit runs true to size, maybe slightly snug in shoulders if you're broad.

These do a decent job keeping my tall leather boots from slouching over in the closet. The spring wire design is easy to slide in and they hold the shaft upright without much fuss. That said, they're pretty flimsy, one of mine arrived slightly bent right out of the package, and I had to reshape it by hand. The plastic loop at the top is fine for hanging but feels like it'll snap if you tug too hard. I'd recommend these to anyone storing mid-range boots that just need basic support, especially ankle-to-knee height styles. If you're trying to preserve expensive designer tall boots, spend the extra money on something sturdier. They get the job done for the price, just don't expect heavy-duty quality.

Got this for recovery after surgery and it's been a lifesaver. No wires, no poking, just soft stretchy fabric that doesn't irritate my incisions at all. I'm normally a 34B and the medium fits with room to spare without being baggy. Would absolutely recommend to anyone dealing with post-op recovery, nursing moms, or really anyone who just wants to feel like they're wearing nothing. My mom tried mine on during a visit and immediately ordered her own. Not gonna lie, I've been living in this thing for three weeks straight. Will probably grab a second one because I'm tired of washing the same bra every night. If you need something for work or high-impact stuff, skip it. But for lazy weekends and recovery? This is the one.

I wasn't expecting much from a multipack, but these seriously exceeded my expectations. The fabric weight is substantial without being stiff, way better than the paper-thin shirts you usually get at this price. I'm a medium and the fit was spot on, maybe slightly relaxed but not boxy. After a handful of washes there's zero shrinkage, which honestly surprised me. No collar warping either. I bought these as gym undershirts but honestly I've been wearing them around the house on weekends too. They don't cling weirdly or show sweat patches like my old Hanes did. My only complaint is I didn't buy two packs upfront. Grabbed the white set but now I'm eyeing the grey. Easily the best basic tee purchase I've made in years.

Honestly didn't expect much for the price but this jacket blew me away. The material feels way more substantial than I thought it would, not that thin, flimsy fleece you usually get at this price point. It's got some real weight to it without being bulky. I was worried it'd look sloppy based on some of the reviews, but it actually has a nice structured fit. I'm 5'7 and around 190, went with a large and it hits right at the hip with sleeves that actually reach my wrists for once. Wore it on a chilly morning walk and stayed perfectly warm. The zipper is smooth and doesn't catch like cheaper jackets I've owned. Way better than what I anticipated, might grab another color honestly.

I honestly didn't expect much for the price, but these completely blew me out of the water. Figured they'd be a cheap throwaway pair for quick errands, but they've turned into my everyday go-to. The quality is way beyond what I anticipated, the material feels solid and they've held up to constant wear without any signs of falling apart. Breaking them in took maybe two days, and now they fit like a glove. I've worn them in pouring rain and freezing mornings, and my feet stayed warm and dry every single time. Way better constructed than some name brands I've paid triple for. If you're on the fence, just get them. They outperform their price tag by a mile and then some.

Wasn't sure what to expect ordering a watch online but this thing absolutely delivers in person. The photos don't really capture how rich the olive tone is, it's way more vibrant and layered than I imagined. The bezel detail with the gold accents pops without looking gaudy or over the top. I've got maybe fifteen watches in my rotation and this one jumped straight to the top. Fair warning though, it runs big. I have larger wrists so it sits perfectly for me, but if you're used to slim watches it might overwhelm your arm. Build quality feels way above what I paid. Honestly expected something cheaper feeling based on the listing but the weight and finish are legit. Zero regrets on this purchase.

Bought this for a beach trip back in June and it looked great for the first couple of wears. The fit is definitely snug so keep that in mind when ordering. My main issue is how it's held up after a few months. I've washed it on gentle and hung it to dry every time, but the fabric is already pilling pretty badly under the arms and along the side seams. The stitching near the hem has started coming loose too. For the price I guess it's okay as a throwaway summer dress, but I expected it to last more than one season. It's still cute enough to wear around the house but I wouldn't buy it again for regular use.

Got these for my 10 month old who is starting to pull herself up on everything. They stay on way better than socks and the stretchy top makes them easy to get on her chubby little feet. The flower detail is super cute and gets compliments every time we go out. What I really love is the flexible sole, she can still feel the ground which helps with balance, but her feet are protected on rough surfaces outside. They've held up great through crawling, cruising, and a few trips to the park. No blisters or red marks either. I was worried about the price but honestly the quality justifies it. Just ordered the next size up so we're set for when she outgrows these.

I've had this hat for almost two years now and it's been through everything with me. Took it on a week-long Utah hiking trip last summer, wore it gardening all season, and even accidentally ran it through the washing machine once. Still looks great. The brim hasn't gotten floppy or lost its shape like every other sun hat I've owned. The chin strap is clutch on windy days, snaps right off if you don't need it. What really impressed me is the fabric hasn't faded at all despite constant sun exposure. My old Columbia hat started looking rough after maybe six months. This one still looks nearly new. Fits true to size and doesn't give me a headache on long wear days like some adjustable hats do. Genuinely worth every penny.

Took these on a week-long hiking trip in Utah and they held up perfectly. The waistband sits right where it should without digging in, and the fabric has enough stretch to scramble over rocks without feeling restricted. I'm 5'7 and around 160 lbs, ordered a medium, and the length hits a couple inches above my knee which is exactly what I wanted. They dry super fast after a river crossing too, which was a pleasant surprise. The pockets are deep enough that my phone doesn't fall out when sitting down. After washing them a few times now, no shrinking or fading. Honestly I might order another pair in a different color because these have basically become my go-to for anything outside. Worth every penny.

I really wanted to love this bathrobe since the material feels decently soft at first touch, but after wearing it for about three weeks I'm pretty underwhelmed. The fit is just weird, the shoulders are super boxy but the sleeves run short, so it feels awkward to actually lounge in. The belt loops are placed too high on the torso, which means the whole thing bunches up weirdly around my waist. I threw it in the wash on cold like the tag suggested and the seams along the pockets already started fraying. For the price I honestly expected better construction. It's not the worst robe I've owned but I wouldn't buy it again or recommend it to anyone. Pretty disappointing overall and definitely not worth what they're charging.

Bought this for my daily commute and it's been solid through a few rainy weeks now. Opens quick with the auto button, which is great when I'm juggling a coffee and my bag. The canopy isn't huge but it covers me fine at 5'9", and it folds down small enough to live in my work backpack permanently. My only gripe is the handle feels a little slippery when wet, some texture would help. That said, for under twenty bucks you really can't complain. It's already outlasted the cheap drugstore one I had before, and the wind hasn't flipped it inside out yet. For the price, this is a great backup or everyday umbrella that won't make you cry if you accidentally leave it somewhere.

Honestly expected a bit more for the price tag. The exterior looks sharp enough, genuine leather feel, nice stitching, and the glass top is a real plus over acrylic. Where it falls short is the interior. The divider system is fiddly and the inserts feel flimsy, like they'll bend or snap if you rearrange them more than a couple times. The compartments themselves are decently sized but the padding on the lid doesn't sit flush, so watches shift around when you close it. Clasp works fine but has a slightly tinny sound to it. Overall it's a presentable storage option that gets the job done, just don't expect heirloom-level build quality. Three stars because it looks better than it functions.

I was honestly shocked by how soft and stretchy this material is. I'm 5'4", around 160 lbs, and a 34C, and it fits like a glove. The ruching on the sides is my favorite part because it actually stays in place instead of riding up every time I move. I wore mine under a cardigan to work and then by itself for drinks after, and it held up great both ways. The v-neck sits perfectly, not too low that I'm tugging at it all day, but low enough to be flattering. My only tiny complaint is that the armholes are a bit snug, but nothing uncomfortable. Washed it on cold and hung it dry with zero shrinkage. Already ordered the black one. Definitely size-friendly if you're on the fence!

Finally found shapewear that actually stays put all day. I'm 5'6" and around 180 lbs, went with the XL based on the size chart and it's perfect. Wore it to a wedding last weekend under a fitted dress and everything looked smooth, no weird bumps or seams showing through. The best part is I forgot I even had it on halfway through the night. Didn't roll down at the waist or ride up on the legs like every other brand I've tried. Hand washed it a few times now and the elasticity is still going strong. Bought the black first, just ordered the nude too. Honestly for the price these are way better than the expensive department store ones I've wasted money on.

I've had these booties for about four months now and they've held up surprisingly well. I was worried the ankle strap might start showing wear since I buckle and unbuckle them constantly, but the hardware is still solid and nothing has torn or frayed. The sole has good grip too, no slipping on wet pavement and barely any visible wear on the heel block even with daily commuting. My one complaint is they took a solid two weeks to break in. The first few wears gave me blisters on my heels, but once the leather softened up they became genuinely comfortable for all-day wear. They've survived rain, puddles, and being shoved in my gym bag. For the price, I'm impressed with how well they're holding up. Would buy again.

I've had my eye on Cushe for a while and finally picked up a pair. Honestly, I expected them to be comfortable based on the hype, but they exceeded what I was anticipating. Right out of the box, no blisters or stiff sole issues. The arch support is decent, not amazing, but solid enough for all-day walking. My only minor complaint is they run slightly narrow through the toe box, so if you have wider feet, definitely size up. The build quality feels solid and the tread grips well on wet pavement. Compared to other casual shoes I've tried in this price range, these are a step above. Took maybe a week of regular wear to fully break in, but now they feel like slippers. Would buy again.

I honestly didn't expect much for the price, but these completely blew me out of the water. I'm a size 6 and grabbed the small, perfect fit. They sit right around mid-thigh, which I was actually glad about because shorter shapewear tends to roll up on me. These stay put all day with zero tugging or adjusting. The material is super lightweight and surprisingly thin. I worried that meant they wouldn't do much, but they smooth everything out without squeezing the life out of you. No muffin top, no visible lines under my bodycon dress. The seamless bottom edge is genius, totally invisible under clingy fabrics. Way better than the expensive brand I usually buy. Already ordered a second pair in black.

Got these hoping they'd be my new everyday kicks, and honestly they're just okay. The build quality is decent, stitching is clean and the materials feel like they'll hold up. But I expected way more cushioning based on the product photos. After a full day of walking, my arches were aching. They run about a half size big, which I kind of guessed from other feedback, so dropping down worked out. The wide toe box is nice if you've got wider feet like me. Overall they look good with jeans and aren't terrible for the price, but I wouldn't call them the comfortable all-day shoes they're marketed as. Fine for casual wear, just don't expect miracles.

Bought this three-piece set in white about eight months ago before a trip to Europe, and I've since taken it on four more flights. Honestly didn't expect much for the price, but these have held up way better than my old Samsonite. The hard shell has survived baggage handlers at three different airports without a single crack or scuff. The wheels still glide smoothly even on carpet, and the telescoping handle hasn't gotten stuck once. The vertical texture does seem to hide minor scratches pretty well, mine still looks almost new. The largest size fits a ton of stuff, maybe too much because I went over the weight limit on my last flight. The medium one is perfect for a week-long trip. No complaints at all, would definitely buy again.

Been using this thing every single morning for almost two years now and it's still going strong. I bought it originally for my work boots that get nasty during the winter months, but honestly my whole family uses it now. My kid's soccer cleats go on after every practice, my wife uses it for her running shoes, and I've even thrown damp gloves on there a few times. The heating elements still work just as well as day one and the plastic hasn't cracked or warped at all despite daily use. I was worried it'd burn out after a season but this thing is built to last. The timer knob still clicks perfectly too. Worth every penny if you deal with wet shoes on the regular.

Jacket arrived two days earlier than expected, which was a nice surprise. It came in a simple poly bag with no extra packaging or tags hanging off it, basically ready to wear straight out of the bag. No weird chemical smell either, which I've gotten from other rain shells ordered online. First impression is solid. The material feels lightweight but not flimsy, and the zippers move smoothly without catching. I like that it stuffs into its own pocket for packing. Tried it on with a fleece underneath and there's plenty of room without looking boxy. The cuffs have a decent grip. Haven't tested it in actual rain yet but the water-resistant finish beads up when I sprinkle it. Wish it came in more colors. Happy so far.

At thirty bucks a pair I expected better. The denim feels noticeably thinner than the Levi's I bought five years ago, and I can already see fading around the knees after just a few washes. The fit is fine and they're comfortable enough for everyday wear, but I don't see these lasting more than a year with regular use. My older pairs held up for ages with no issues. Seems like they've cut corners on material quality while keeping the same price tag. For what you're paying, the construction just isn't there anymore. They're okay if you catch them on sale, but honestly I'd look elsewhere if you want jeans that actually hold up. Disappointing for a brand I used to trust.

Ordered this for a wedding next month and picked Prime delivery since I needed it fast. Shipped same day and arrived in a bubble mailer inside a sealed polybag, no weird chemical smell, which was a relief. Fabric felt slightly thin straight out of the package, so I gave it a quick cold wash and hang dry. That perked it right up. Tried it on and was honestly shocked at how well it skimmed my curves without clinging in weird spots. The navy is more muted than the stock photos suggest, almost a dusty tone, but it works beautifully with gold accessories. No loose threads, hems were even, and the stretch is just right. Genuinely impressed for the price point. Grabbing the black one too.

I've been searching forever for a comfortable bra to wear around the house and this one finally hits the mark. The wide shoulder straps are the real standout for me, they don't dig in or leave grooves like so many other styles I've tried. I'm a 38D and the support is surprisingly solid for something without much structure. The band stays put without rolling up, which is a problem I usually run into. Sure, it's not the prettiest thing in my drawer and I wouldn't pick it for going out, but for lounging on weekends or working from home it's perfect. The fabric is soft and hasn't pilled after several washes. At this price I might grab a second one.

I've been putting these through hell for about six months now and they still look practically new. Living in the Pacific Northwest, I needed something that could handle wet roots, mud, and sharp rocks without falling apart. These deliver. The outsole grip is aggressive enough that I haven't slipped once on slick terrain, even on steep descents. What really impressed me though is how the upper has held up. Usually by now I'd see fraying or the toe guard separating, but everything is solid. The cable lacing system took some getting used to but once dialed in, they stay locked down for hours. Still comfortable enough for long days on the trail. Honestly the best trail shoes I've owned and I've gone through plenty.

I've had my eye on these boots for months and finally pulled the trigger when they went on sale. Completely exceeded my expectations. The leather is substantial but not stiff, felt broken in after just a couple days of wearing them around the house. I'm normally a solid 7.5 and ordered that size. Snug at first across the toes but molded to my feet perfectly within a week. The craftsmanship is legit, clean stitching, no weird glue marks, solid sole with real grip. I've worn them with jeans, leggings, even a midi dress and they just work. My only minor complaint is the zipper was a little sticky initially, but a bit of wax fixed that right up. Absolutely would buy again.

I was pretty skeptical about these boots given the price, and honestly I expected them to feel stiff or take weeks to break in. Turns out they were comfortable straight out of the box. I work retail and I'm on my feet for eight hour shifts, usually dealing with sore arches and achy knees by the end of the day. With these, my feet actually feel fine when I clock out. The sole has way more cushioning than I anticipated and the ankle support is solid without feeling restrictive. They run a little wide which worked out great for me but might be an issue if you have narrow feet. Only minor complaint is they're heavier than I expected, but that's a fair tradeoff for the support. Way beyond what I was hoping for.

The fabric on this skirt is really pretty and has a nice weight to it, not cheap or flimsy like I expected for the price. I ordered my usual medium and honestly it fits more like a small, so definitely size up at least one. I'm normally a solid 8 and the medium was pretty snug through the waistband. That said, the pleats fall nicely and the length hits right above my knee which I love. The zipper feels a little flimsy so be gentle when pulling it up. I wore it to brunch last weekend and got a bunch of compliments. Took off a star because the pockets are basically decorative, you can barely fit a phone in there. Overall a cute skirt if you get the right size.

Picked this up as a backup for interviews and the occasional wedding, and honestly I'm pretty impressed for what I paid. The face has a nice clean look that passes for something way more expensive, and the band is comfortable enough for all-day wear. It keeps time accurately so far after about three weeks of use. My only real complaint is the clasp feels a little lightweight, like it might not hold up forever with heavy use. But for the price point, you really can't complain. I've gotten a couple compliments on it already and nobody suspects it cost what it did. If you need a decent dress watch without dropping serious money, this gets the job done. Would buy again if mine ever gets scratched up.
